bias.zh: 下降趋势 · 跌回 $130.8–133.8 和 5 日均线下方

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 3.5% on Nov 10 to $129.66, trading $127.39–135.15 on light volume (0.60x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($131.7), 10-day ($143.3) and 30-day ($154.4); all three averages are falling (no 100-day or 200-day yet, 87 sessions). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($163.48), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月10日下跌 3.5%，收于 $129.66，盘中区间 $127.39–135.15，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.60 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$131.7）、10 日（$143.3）和 30 日（$154.4）均线下方；三条均线均在下行（上市仅 87 个交易日，尚无 100、200 日均线）。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$163.48），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The close lost the $130.8–133.8 support (Oct 22 and Aug 7 lows) after the $135.15 high stalled under $135.6; that zone and the 5-day ($131.7) are now resistance. Resistance is $130.8–133.8, then $135.2–135.6 (Nov 9–10 highs) and $141.2 (Nov 4 low). Support is $124.8–127.4 (Jul 29, Nov 9 and Nov 10 lows), then $122.2 (lowest since listing). A close above $133.8 would target $135.6; below $124.8, $122.2.

r.en: 5-day average $131.7; Oct 22 low $130.79; Aug 7 low $133.8, lost

s.en: Nov 10 low $127.39; Nov 9 low $125.83; Jul 29 low $124.8

bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 117–120 万韩元，仍低于 125 万韩元

read.en: SK hynix's latest Seoul close is ₩1,212,000, up from ₩1,136,000 in the previous read; the latest full session ranged ₩1,190,000–1,242,000. It is above the falling 5-day (₩1,191,200) and below the falling 10-day (₩1,316,600), 30-day (₩1,431,867) and 100-day (₩1,763,690) and the rising 200-day (₩1,514,335). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 (₩1,523,635), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: SK 海力士首尔最新收盘价为 ₩1,212,000，高于上次解读的 ₩1,136,000；最近一个完整交易日区间为 ₩1,190,000–1,242,000。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（₩1,191,200）上方，下行的 10 日（₩1,316,600）、30 日（₩1,431,867）和 100 日均线（₩1,763,690）以及上行的 200 日均线（₩1,514,335）下方。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（₩1,523,635），RSI 为 39。

read.en: The rebound cleared the ₩1,171,000 Oct 22 low, the ₩1,204,000 Oct 21 low and the 5-day, now support; the ₩1,242,000 high stopped under the ₩1,246,000–1,250,000 band. Resistance is ₩1,242,000–1,250,000 (latest high, Jul 28 and Nov 4 lows), then ₩1,316,600 (10-day) and ₩1,373,000 (Aug 10 low). Support is ₩1,190,000–1,204,000, then ₩1,171,000 and ₩1,089,000. A close above ₩1,250,000 would target ₩1.32 million; below ₩1,190,000, ₩1.17 million.

s.en: Latest low ₩1,190,000; 5-day average ₩1,191,200; Oct 21 low ₩1,204,000, reclaimed

s.zh: 11月5日低点，4 月中旬以来最低
